name: shell-panel
title: Shell Panel
description: The shell's one right-hand panel — a 48px head with a tab row (italic preview tabs, pinned icons, change dots, drag or keys to reorder, a right-click menu, ▾ overflow with Recently closed), tab bodies kept alive under Activity, a resizable start edge and the Escape rule.

meta.whenToUse: Inside Shell's panel slot: every record, record view or assistant chat opened beside the page as a tab.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form, a confirmation or a picker (Dialog, AlertDialog, ResponsiveDialog), or a page's own section tabs (Tabs).
